track.name: market-research
track.label: Market Research
track.summary: Learn to design and run primary and secondary research studies, analyse qualitative and quantitative data, and turn findings into clear, actionable recommendations for stakeholders.

phases.title: Fundamentals
phases.description: Understand what market research is, the difference between primary and secondary research, and when to use each approach.

phases.title: Qualitative Methods
phases.description: Master in-depth interviews, focus groups, and ethnographic research — then learn to code and analyse transcripts systematically.

phases.title: Quantitative Methods
phases.description: Design surveys with sound scales and sampling strategies, run A/B tests, and apply conjoint analysis to measure trade-off preferences.

phases.title: Secondary Research & Data Sources
phases.description: Navigate desk research, industry reports, competitive intelligence, and free public data sources effectively.

phases.title: Consumer Insights & Segmentation
phases.description: Build research-backed personas, apply psychographic and behavioural segmentation models, and use the Jobs-to-Be-Done framework.

phases.title: Synthesis & Presentation
phases.description: Turn raw findings into clear recommendations, write compelling executive summaries, and communicate research to stakeholders.

resources.title: Market Research: Definition, Types, and Analysis

resources.title: How to Do Market Research: The Complete Guide
